dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The lateral flank features a series of interlocking, irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored structures. These exhibit jagged, crenulated perimeters with a sharp gradient transition from the dark dorsal pelt to a light-gray interior. The boundaries are non-uniform, showing high-frequency spatial variation in line thickness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity clusters. Isolated, small-scale concentrations of bright pixels are visible along the superior dorsal ridge and the posterior-lateral boundary, appearing as localized flecks rather than structured gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest annuli on the mid-lateral surface form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the primary axis oriented approximately parallel to the mid-dorsal curvature of the visible body segment.

other_distinctive_markers: A diffuse, high-intensity light-colored band extends along the upper dorsal midline, transitioning into the more defined, interlocking mottled topology on the lateral surface.
